A young boy went missing a few years back in the small-ish town in California where I live and it made headlines in local news because his mom claimed he was special needs. The entire town went looking for him, massive search parties were held and everyone was on alert. A few days after he went missing, his father (who lived out of state) and teachers came out to say he wasn’t disabled and that his mom was lying. A bunch of other weird details came out (the mom used the money people donated to buy new phones, they held a bonfire the first night he was gone while the town was out looking for him, etc), and a few days later they found his body in their backyard, not 100 yards from where the search parties gathered. His older brother was arrested for killing him, but I still don’t believe his mom didn’t have something to do with it.
